title_zh: 中国语言资源保护工程成果展示馆开馆 沈晓明宣布开馆
title_en: Exhibition Hall of China Language Resources Protection Project Opens, Shen Xiaoming Announces Opening
summary_zh: 8月24日，中国语言资源保护工程成果展示馆在长沙开馆，湖南省委书记沈晓明宣布开馆。
summary_en: On August 24, the exhibition hall of the China Language Resources Protection Project opened in Changsha, with Shen Xiaoming, Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee, announcing its opening.
